messages.text: Hi, I sent back the blue mug from my last order because it arrived chipped. Can I get a refund?

tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"refund returned item arrived chipped, damaged item exceptions and process"}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/return", "title": "Items must be returned first", "text": "The shop refunds only units it has received back, as shown by its own return records, never by a statement of the customer or the assistant. If the records show the units arrived, the request continues normally. If they do not, the shop pays nothing for those units; if the customer says the units were already sent, a staff member checks."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/exceptions", "title": "Exceptions and talking to a person", "text": "Anything this policy does not cover, and any request for an exception, goes to a staff member. The customer can ask for a person at any time."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/eligible-orders", "title": "Which orders qualify", "text": "Only orders with the status \"delivered\" can receive a refund. An order that has not been delivered is not refunded through this process; if the customer reports a delivery that never arrived, a staff member takes the case. If a delivered order has no delivery time, or one that cannot be right (before the purchase or in the future), a staff member takes the case."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}
